topic: Secure embed shared dashboard ignores template variable values added to selectable_template_vars after the share was created
environment: Datadog dashboard shared as a secure embed
Signed embed URLs with tpl_var_* parameters (HMAC-SHA256)
Widgets built on log queries that use the template variables
symptom_pattern: Template variable preselection through the embed URL works only for values that were in selectable_template_vars[].visible_tags when the share was created. Values added later through 'Edit Default Variables' are saved, returned by the shared-dashboard API and shown in the embed's filter bar. The widgets still return unfiltered data for them. The regular dashboard and Log Explorer apply the same values correctly. A second secure embed whose values were all declared at creation filters correctly. Waiting, pausing and resuming the share, and shrinking the tenant list did not help.
root_cause: Not confirmed by the thread. The support engineer's working hypothesis was a platform bug: the secure embed's query-time validation seems to check incoming tpl_var_* values against a snapshot of visible_tags taken at share creation, not against the current share state. This was never verified server-side. The customer's test showed that values declared at creation are applied and values added afterwards are not.
resolution_path: The customer created a second secure embed on the same dashboard with the same settings and the full visible_tags lists declared at creation
They signed embed URLs against the new share for values that had been added to the original share, and the widgets filtered correctly
The numbers matched the dashboard itself (one count differed by 1 from the dashboard)
The customer switched their application to the new share and paused the original one
The customer noted that future additions to the list would still force them to recreate the share and rotate the credential, so a fix on the Datadog side is still wanted
info_needed: Share token of the affected secure embed
Approximate time and timezone of the visible_tags edit
Whether any other secure embed shows the problem after post-creation edits to the allow-list

qa_pairs.tse_question: Can you share the token for the affected secure embed?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: The customer supplied the original share's id and token, its creation time, and said it was now paused and could be resumed for investigation.

qa_pairs.tse_question: Is this the only secure embed where you have seen this, or have you seen it on others where the allow-list was edited after creation?
qa_pairs.customer_answer: The only other secure embed they run is on a different dashboard, and they have not seen the issue there.

customer_style.tone: Professional, precise and data-driven; supplied side-by-side comparisons and reproduced the fix themselves

steps: Acknowledged the customer's comparison data and identified the pattern: values present at creation filter, values added later do not
Explained why pausing, resuming and waiting would not have helped under that hypothesis
Explained why the other embed was unaffected: all its values were declared at creation
Said this looked like a platform bug rather than a configuration error, while noting it might change with further investigation
Asked for the share token, the time of the edit and whether other embeds were affected
Said they would check internal state and flag the issue for engineering review
key_questions: Share token for the affected secure embed
Approximate time with timezone of the visible_tags edit, to correlate with audit and access logs
Whether any other secure embed with post-creation allow-list edits shows the issue
communication: Thanked the customer for specific details, gave a clear hypothesis and linked each of the customer's observations to it. Was upfront that the hypothesis was tentative. Gave a short numbered list of what was needed next and why, and said what they would do next.
